name: alls-green
description: GitHub Action for checking that the test matrix jobs are all successful before proceeding. To be used in branch protection

jobs.description: A list of jobs from the `needs` context, serialized as a JSON string via `toJSON(needs)`

allowed-failures.description: Job names that are allowed to fail and not affect the outcome, as a comma-separated list or serialized as a JSON string

allowed-skips.description: Job names that are allowed to be skipped and not affect the outcome, as a comma-separated list or serialized as a JSON string
